description:
Specifies the language which will be used to check spelling and grammar (if requested) when processing
the contents of the current paragraph.

params.description: The possible value for this parameter is a language identifier as defined byRFC 4646/BCP 47. Example: "en-CA". Pass _null_ to remove the language.
params.name: langId

returns.description: returns null if the language identifier is not supported.
